comment: You will learn academic research and writing. You will learn how to disagree with her. You have to learn to debate based on facts, your own analysis, and articulation of your perspective. Great in student relations, accessible outside of classroom. Fun and engaging personality. Classes are definitely not boring. Highly recommended.

A really interesting and cool woman, but not a good professor. Readings are varied but usually unnecessary for class until a project worth 1/4 of your grade is handed out the day before it's due. Grades are entirely subjective with no criteria to base them off of and you'll never know what she's looking for until you get grades back. Not worth it.

Grading system is completely subjective. Many readings but not really necessarily as discussions in class often get drifted away anyway. Never know what she wants from us for assignments. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS.

Dr. Carapico is da bomb! You are either gonna hate her or love her. There's no in-between honestly! Her prompts are very confusing, but I loved taking this class. I gained a much more thorough knowledge of middle eastern affairs. You will have to read many articles, participate in class discussions and listen to her experience as a Yemen-expert.

Dr. Carapico is a very smart woman and has spent many years in Middle East. However, her teaching skills are not the best. There are a lot of readings -some interesting some not- and papers with unclear prompts. I never understood what she actually wanted from us. Her grading criteria are also unclear. Take her  PLSC of Middle East  affairs better!

Carapico is a brilliant researcher and a nice woman, but she's not a good professor. I've had her twice, and each time I've hoped it would get better.. It doesn't. She's rarely prepared, doesn't answer questions. Grading system is erratic. She doesn't really teach anything. This is not just me; all my classmates felt the same.

Carapico is interesting. She has an unorthodox way of teaching which some people do not like. The class is heavily discussion oriented. If you dont read you wont be able to participate. There was only 10-20 page articles per class NO BIGGIE. Mid Term and Final were Take Home essays. Participation is key but class is interesting and educating.

She makes up facts, which generally tend to be biased.  She compared Hamas to the republican party and said they were generally on the same level of conservative fundamentalism, are you kidding me?  She has no clear agenda for the class, she talks about whatever pops into her head and her telling of events changes every time she recounts them.
Excellent class and professor!  Really knows her stuff.

She's very intelligent, but she doesn't know anything about economics, which forms a good 60% of what this class is about, so if you don't have a decent econ background - good luck. Very discussion oriented, not too many big assignments (although the readings can be a pain). Helpful outside of class.
Worst teacher in the department.  VERY BIASED.  All conservatives and moderates should stay away.
She is incredibly slanted in her political views - extremely liberal.  Don't take her if you aren't a card carrying member of the ACLU!!
Awesome class!  I learned so much, and I'm not a poli sci major at all...be prepared to work though
Hard, but awesome professor - you will learn a lot.  Prof. Carapico is not afraid to share her opinions and it is interesting to hear her views, particularly on conflicts in the Middle East.

Very hard teacher just by the amount of work she assigns.  There is long reading assignments coupled with short essays for each class.  She is extremely smart and knows her stuff, but do not take unless you are prepared to work.
She's very knowledgeable and well qualified, but she's really hard in her grading.  Her grading procedures are unclear and she is very unorganized.
No Comments
She's knows alot about the subject, but she expects a lot out of the students.  If you're not into polysci or econ, don't take this class with her!

Shes a weirdo.  But shes cool and she will entertain any conversation the class feels like having.  Shes got a cool dog.  I think shes hot.  She likes Yemen and shes a liberal.  But if you write a paper with a tight case she'll reward it.  peace.
I loved her!  her class was extremely hard, but if you do the work you will do well.  her classes are fun and she knows what she is talking about.  i would take a class with her again!
If you're a man, best of luck in her class!

I think if this werent a class and you were just allowed to sit in there and listen to her speak about IR it would be so much better.  She is very interesting and would recomend her to anyone willing to do the frequent long readings.

Conservatives/moderates beware.  This teacher is a liberal intellectual who brings a clear bias to the class.  Don't believe me? Her readings that presented anti-Bush sentiments (like one written by Soros)far outweighed those that were favorable by 3/
Amazing prof. Take a class with her, regardless of the subject material. She'll make it interesting, even if it's less than enthralling.
Great prof
Not only a great professor, but has an influential voice in the international political economic scene.  Look up her cv, your jaw will drop!
Best professor I've ever had.

What are you talking about? Dr. Carapico is an incredible professor.  This is the second class I have taken with her, and she has done nothing but amaze me with her intelligence and willingness to help students. Take a class with here if at all possib
